movelist.name: Future Sight
movelist.effect: Future Sight does nothing on the turn it is used. At the end of the user’s next turn, Future Sight hits, even if the user is no longer on the field. Future Sight cannot miss.

movelist.name: Imprison
movelist.effect: The target is Locked for the rest of the Scene. A Locked target may not use any Moves the user knows. Imprison cannot miss.

movelist.name: Psychic
movelist.effect: The target is Pushed 1 meter in any direction. Psychic lowers the target’s Special Defense 1 Combat Stage on 17+.

movelist.name: Calm Mind
movelist.effect: Raise the user’s Special Attack 1 Combat Stage and raise the user’s Special Defense 1 Combat Stage.

movelist.name: Draining Kiss
movelist.effect: After the target takes damage, the user gains Hit Points equal to half of the damage they dealt to the target.

movelist.name: Heal Pulse
movelist.effect: Restores 50% of the target’s max Hit Points. Heal Pulse’s user may not target itself with Heal Pulse.

abilities.name: Synchronize
abilities.trigger: The user is Paralyzed, Frozen, Burned,
abilities.effect: The foe which caused the Status Condition is given the same Status they inflicted.

abilities.name: Telepathy
abilities.effect: The user gains +1 Evasion. Whenever an Ally uses a damaging area-of-effect attack that would hit you, you may Disengage as a Free Action before the attack resolves.

abilities.name: Trace
abilities.effect: The Pokémon gains an Ability known by the Target for the remainder of the encounter, or until it is Fainted.
